scripts.dev: npm run runtime:sync && npm run terrain:sync && node tools/dev/dev-hotreload.mjs
scripts.build: npm run runtime:sync && npm run wasm:build && vite build --config web/vite.config.js
scripts.lint:prepush: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:rust
scripts.bench:fetch:glofas: CDSAPI_RC=.cdsapirc python3 bench/scripts/fetch-glofas-historical.py --start-year 1979 --end-year 1985 --out-dir bench/raw/hydrology/glofas_raw --system-version version_4_0 --hydrological-model lisflood --days 01,08,15,22,29
scripts.bench:resample:ecology-ref: python3 bench/scripts/resample.py --module ecology-ref --centroids bench/data/cell_centroids.csv --output bench/data/ecology_ref.bin --tree-cover bench/raw/ecology/mod44b_tree_cover.tif --non-tree-cover bench/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_tree_cover.tif --bare-cover bench/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_vegetated.tif --landcover bench/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_type1.tif --landuse bench/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_prop2.tif --temperature bench/raw/climate/worldclim_tavg_annual_c.tif --precipitation bench/raw/climate/worldclim_prec_annual_mm.tif --river-flow bench/raw/hydrology/glofas_era5_annual_mean.nc --height bench/raw/geology/ETOPO_2022_v1_60s_N90W180_surface.tif --method bilinear
scripts.bench:resample:ecology-ref:with-soil: python3 bench/scripts/resample.py --module ecology-ref --centroids bench/data/cell_centroids.csv --output bench/data/ecology_ref.bin --tree-cover bench/raw/ecology/mod44b_tree_cover.tif --non-tree-cover bench/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_tree_cover.tif --bare-cover bench/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_vegetated.tif --landcover bench/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_type1.tif --landuse bench/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_prop2.tif --temperature bench/raw/climate/worldclim_tavg_annual_c.tif --precipitation bench/raw/climate/worldclim_prec_annual_mm.tif --river-flow bench/raw/hydrology/glofas_era5_annual_mean.nc --height bench/raw/geology/ETOPO_2022_v1_60s_N90W180_surface.tif --soil-dir bench/raw/ecology/soilgrids --soil-suffix 0p1deg --soil-w-0-5 5 --soil-w-5-15 3.5 --soil-w-15-30 1.5 --method bilinear
scripts.wasm:build: npm run terrain:sync && wasm-pack build rust --target web --out-dir ../generated/wasm/web --release
scripts.wasm:build:dev: npm run terrain:sync && wasm-pack build rust --target web --out-dir ../generated/wasm/web --dev
